integrity: The analytic second-variation proof specifies all normalizations, orbital kernel and sharp mode. An accompanying reproducible numerical and exact-symbolic consistency checker is not a substitute for proof. Historical priority is provisional; no independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local labelled ten-point stability on the Euclidean unit three-sphere, with distance measured by squared summed vertex displacement to a common orthogonal orbit. Not a sharp global stability theorem, not a Hausdorff-distance result, and not a result on other vertex counts. Global maximization and uniqueness are credited to Medgyes; priority over all earlier quantitative notes cannot be certified.
title: Sharp local volume stability of the ten-vertex inscribed four-polytope
